business_problem: To rise above the pack in the mobile gaming industry, it’s essential to give users superimmersive experiences that offer endless hours of entertainment. SciPlay, the mobile games company behind mega-hits like Jackpot Party and Quick Hit Casino, saw the need to enhance its data-driven approach to further engage customers and build games they’ll love.
solution_summary: SciPlay built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, MLflow.
